class.name: DV_RadarGraph
class.brief_description: Spider/radar graph for a single series across named categories, with configurable grid, label display, and styling.
class.description:
[code]DV_RadarGraph[/code] plots one numeric value per category around a circular web. Provide category names with [code]set_categories()[/code] and values with [code]set_data_points()[/code]. The array lengths are expected to match. The radial scale maps from [member min_value] to [member max_value]. Visual details such as grid rings, outline, fill, and point markers are controlled by the [member *] and [member *] members.
[codeblocks] [gdscript]
extends DV_RadarGraph
func _ready() -> void: # Grid/web and labels set_layer_count(5) set_rotate_labels_to_center(true) set_show_grid(true) set_show_labels(true) set_show_points(true)
# Value range (min..max) set_min_value(0.0) set_max_value(100.0)
# Data var cats0 := PackedStringArray(["Stealth","Lockpicking","Crafting","Combat","Acrobatics"]) var vals0 := PackedFloat32Array([72, 65, 48, 55, 83]) set_categories(cats0) set_data_points(vals0)
_randomize_values() queue_redraw()
func _randomize_values() -> void: var rng := RandomNumberGenerator.new() rng.randomize() var vals := get_data_points() var n := vals.size() if n == 0: return for i in n: vals[i] = clampf(rng.randf_range(20.0, 100.0), get_min_value(), get_max_value()) set_data_points(vals) queue_redraw() [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

members.member: Category labels arranged around the radar. The number of categories should match [member data_points].
One value per category. Values are plotted radially between [member min_value] and [member max_value].
Pixel margin between the outer web and category labels.
Number of concentric grid rings drawn from center to outer radius.
Maximum value of the radial scale.
Minimum value of the radial scale.
When [code]true[/code], rotates each label so its baseline points toward the chart center.
Toggles drawing of the radial grid (rings and spokes).
Toggles drawing of point markers at each vertex.
Fill color for the polygon area under the outline.
Color used for grid rings and spokes.
Color of the data outline connecting category vertices.
Pixel thickness of the data outline.
Color of point markers when [member show_points] is enabled.
Radius (in pixels) of each point marker.
